title: harden(keys): minting an API key requires an interactive session
body:
Dispatched by the W3-C3b QA run security path (detail withheld)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:创建 API key(`POST /api/v1/keys`)现在只接受登录会话发起的请求;用 API key 认证的请求一律 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`,不写任何数据。
- 为什么改:安全加固。创建凭据属于凭据生命周期操作,应当由账号本人登录后完成,不应由一把 key 代办。
- 风险与回滚:风险在于曾用 API key 调用该接口的脚本会改为收到 403;控制台、Connect an Agent 页面和带会话的调用不受影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts`(新增的会话判定,紧跟匿名判定之后、读取请求体之前);`packages/runtime/src/domains/keys-mint-interactive-session.pin.test.ts`;`packages/runtime/src/api-key-lifecycle.pin.test.ts` 中改写的 control 用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/domains/keys-mint-interactive-session.pin.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`POST /api/v1/keys` mints only for a principal that a signed-in session admitted.

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts`: right after the anonymous decision (ADR-0138 D2) and before the body is read, the domain asks `HttpProtocolContext.admission.credential`, which the dispatcher's identity step writes from the shared resolver (`resolveAuthzContext`'s `credential`, via `onAdmission`). Anything other than `'session'` is refused `403`. That covers an API-key admission and also an absent admission, because a credential the door was never told about is not a session. The check is positive on purpose, so a credential kind added later is refused until it is admitted explicitly.
- The refusal is domain-wide, so every verb from a key-admitted caller gets the 403 instead of the 405. A session-admitted caller still gets the 405 for a wrong verb.
- Error code: the existing status-derived `PERMISSION_DENIED`. This route already answers it when the caller is not a member of their active organization. No new code, no ledger change.
- The module header and one inline comment are updated to match. The comment had described the active organization as possibly coming from a minting key's stamp, and only a session reaches that line now.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` patch. It names who is affected and tells embedders that call `HttpDispatcher.handleKeys` directly to record the admitting credential.

## Tests

- New: `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys-mint-interactive-session.pin.test.ts` (14 cases).
  - Through `dispatch()`: session mint is 201 with one row pinned to the session user. An API-key admission in each accepted header spelling (`x-api-key`, `Authorization: ApiKey`, `Authorization: Bearer osk_…`) is refused 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` with nothing written. A cookie beside the key does not lift the refusal. Every verb gets the 403. Controls: a session wrong verb gets 405, anonymous gets 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`.
  - At `handleKeys`: no admission, or an `api_key` admission, is refused with the body unread and no service resolved. A `session` admission mints.
- Fixture triage. Hand-built "signed-in" contexts in seven runtime test files never said which credential admitted them. Each one now declares `admission: { credential: 'session', authGate: undefined }`. No assertion moved.
- One assertion was rewritten: the control `the same key, live, is served` in `api-key-lifecycle.pin.test.ts` used a live key to mint. It now pins what it exists to prove. The live key passes the identity step: `dispatch()` resolves, the admission is `api_key` and the principal is the key's owner. The door then answers with its own rule (403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`), never a lifecycle code.
- Ablation, run once on the committed fix (subject reached through relative `src` imports, so no dist rebuild was involved). `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the session condition with `if (false)`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `2d6f7ad939f2` to `96dff2464c80`. Result: 11 of the 28 cases across the new pin file and the lifecycle pin failed (every refusal case and the rewritten control), and every control stayed green. Restore: blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts`: the `anonymous-deny-keys` row's note says "a signed-in caller reaches the mint exactly as before", which is still true for a session. This PR adds no row for the session requirement (outside this dispatch's file surface). Carrier: the dispatching seat.
- The docs that teach minting (`content/docs/api/index.mdx`, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`) already show session-based minting. None of them says a key cannot mint. A one-line mention there is a follow-up, outside this dispatch's file surface. Carrier: the dispatching seat.
- No `ui/` change: the Console's mint calls (`AgentConnectSection.tsx`, the `create_api_key` action) send the session cookie.
